data.name: Malachi
data.long_meaning: Malachi is a Hebrew name meaning 'My God is Gracious.' In the Bible, Malachi is the last prophet, sent to prepare the way for John the Baptist and Jesus.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes divine grace, faithfulness, and a connection to God.

in_hebrew.name: מלאכי
in_hebrew.meaning: מלאכי - שליחי אלוהים, מלאך ה' (Malachi - Messenger of God, Angel of the Lord)
in_hebrew.long_meaning: מלאכי הוא שם עברי שפירושו 'מלאך ה'' או 'שליחי אלוהים'. השם מורכב משתי מילים: 'מלאך' (מלאך - מלאך, שליח) ו'-י' (סופית שייכות). הנביא מלאכי היה אחרון הנביאים בתנ''ך, שחזה את בואו של ישוע המשיח. השם מלאכי משמש כזכר ונקשר לנבואה ולקיום דבר ה'.

in_greek.name: Μαλαχίας
in_greek.meaning: Μαλαχίας - ο αγγελος του Κυρίου (Malachi - the Angel of the Lord)
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο Μαλαχίας είναι η ελληνική μορφή του εβραϊκού ονόματος מלאכי (Malachi), που σημαίνει 'αγγελος του Θεού' ή 'αγγελος του Κυρίου'. Στο Χριστιανισμό, ο προφήτης Μαλαχίας αναφέρεται ως ο τελευταίος προφήτης της Παλαιάς Διαθήκης, που προανήγγειλε την έλευση του Ιησού Χριστού. Το όνομα Μαλαχίας συνδέεται με την προφητεία και την αποστολή του Θεού.

in_latin.name: Malachias
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Malachias derivatur ex hebraico מלאכי (Malachi), quod significat 'Angelus Domini' vel 'Nuntius Dei'. In Ecclesia Christiana, propheta Malachias consideratur ultimus propheta Veteris Testamenti, qui adventum Iesu Christi praenuntiavit. Nomen Malachias coniungitur cum prophetia et ministerio Dei.

in_english.name: Malachi
in_english.meaning: Messenger of God, Angel of the Lord
in_english.long_meaning: The name Malachi originates from the Hebrew מלאכי (Malachi), meaning 'Messenger of God' or 'Angel of the Lord'. In the Bible, Malachi was the last prophet of the Old Testament, who foretold the coming of Jesus Christ. The name Malachi symbolizes prophecy, spiritual guidance, and divine messaging. It is associated with qualities like leadership, communication, and devotion. Malachi remains a popular name across Christian cultures, signifying a connection to faith and spirituality.

biblical_reference.note: Malachi was a prophet in the Old Testament, and his book is the last in the Hebrew Bible and Christian Old Testament.

data.cultural_impact: The name Malachi has been popular throughout history, particularly in Western cultures due to its religious significance in Christianity. It has been given to numerous children, and is still a common name in some Christian communities.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christianity, Malachi is seen as a symbol of God's grace and mercy, as his name means 'My God is Gracious.' Additionally, as the last prophet in the Old Testament, his message serves as a bridge between the Old and New Testaments, preparing the way for John the Baptist and ultimately, for the arrival of Jesus.

historical_references.context: Prophetic book of the Hebrew Bible

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Malachi remains relevant in modern Christian society, representing a bridge between traditional Biblical values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Christian names.

name_in_real_life.story: A devoted Christian named Ruth Malachi in Jerusalem, Israel credits much of their spiritual journey to their name Malachi, which means "My God is Gracious". They believe their name has been a blessing and reminder of God's presence in their life.

data.spiritual_symbolism: Malachi means "my messenger" or "God's messenger" in Hebrew. This prophet was the last to record God's message in the Old Testament, signifying the coming of a new era.
